desc.short: 漂白旁路风格：高对比、低饱和的银盐胶片质感。

params.strength: 整体效果混合量，0 时完全直通。
params.contrast: 以 18% 灰为锚点的 S 曲线强度，控制阴影下压与高光扩张。
params.saturation: 色彩保留比例，1.0 保留原始色度，0.0 完全银灰。

desc.short: Bleach bypass look: high-contrast, low-saturation silver film response.

params.strength: Overall effect mix, 0 is a full bypass.
params.contrast: S-curve strength anchored at 18% grey; crushes shadows, expands highlights.
params.saturation: Chroma retention ratio, 1.0 keeps original chroma, 0.0 is fully silver.
